summary: Phase 8 (Observe) tested end-to-end. Backend: 50/50 pytest cases pass in serial mode (39 previous + 11 new Phase 8). New endpoints all correct: GET /api/cell/observations returns 5 rows spanning LOG/CODE/SCREEN/MEDIA/EVENT; ?type=CODE filter works; obs-1 GET returns doc and nope returns 404; POST /observations generates obs-<hex> id and records OBSERVATION_CREATED event with actor; GET /artifacts returns 5 rows spanning MARKDOWN/CODE/SCREENSHOT/IMAGE/JSON; ?job_id=job-001 filter returns art-1; POST /artifacts creates with verified=false, truth='UNVERIFIED', records ARTIFACT_CREATED event; POST /artifacts/art-2/verify flips to verified=true/truth=VERIFIED and records ARTIFACT_VERIFIED; POST /artifacts/art-3/verify returns 409 'Cannot verify an artifact whose source is DOWN'; POST /cell/reseed restores clean state incl. observations + artifacts (art-2 back to unverified). No _id leaked anywhere. Frontend: Home shows panel-latest-artifacts with 3 home-artifact-{id} cards — clicking navigates to /operations. Operations has 5 tabs (jobs/builds/loop/verify/observe); work-tab-observe reveals 4 sub-tabs (observe-sub-browser|media|code|artifacts). Browser sub-tab shows 'BROWSER · OFFLINE' with browser-observation testid and browser-retry button (click records diagnostic observation). Media sub-tab: art-3 shows honest 'NO CONTENT — SOURCE IS DOWN' and art-4 renders an image element. Code sub-tab: 3 code-class artifact-stages (MARKDOWN/CODE/JSON) with provenance panels ('Where from', Job, Mission, Created, Truth) visible. Artifacts sub-tab shows all 5 artifact-stage-{id} components. verify-artifact-{id} buttons visible for unverified/verifiable artifacts; verify-artifact-art-3 correctly disabled (DOWN); clicking verify-artifact-art-2 flips row to 'VERIFIED' green tag. Regressions all pass: mission-strip global, DEMO banner visible, view-diff-ap-1 opens diff-viewer, command-palette testid now present on Cmd+K palette, /agents no longer produces 'no route matched' warnings (catch-all redirects to /), all 4 previous work-tabs still work.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend pytest.ini still enables xdist by default; mutation tests can race with /reseed under parallel workers. Run with `-o addopts=` for serial as noted in the task. Not an app bug.

ArtifactCreate model uses field name 'kls' (avoid Python 'class' keyword) then remaps in the handler — works but adds a small API/internal mismatch. Consider using a Pydantic Field(alias='class') to keep external API symmetric with GET responses.
record_event still uses HH:MM:SS only (no date). Fine for demo but ordering across days would be ambiguous.
BrowserObservation retry only records an observation client-side; the CDP adapter itself is a Phase 11 concern per the spec — intentionally deferred.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/cell/reseed called at start of session, before each mutation test, and after frontend testing to restore art-2 unverified and clear ARTIFACT_VERIFIED/OBSERVATION_CREATED events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8 testids verified: work-tab-observe, observe-sub-{browser|media|code|artifacts}, browser-observation, browser-retry, artifact-stage-{id} (art-1..art-5), verify-artifact-{id} (art-3 disabled by design because DOWN, art-2/art-1/art-5 verifiable — art-1 & art-5 start VERIFIED, only art-2 starts UNVERIFIED per seed), panel-latest-artifacts, home-artifact-{id}, command-palette (via Cmd+K). Backend has +7 new endpoints under /api/cell/observations and /api/cell/artifacts. All previous testids still work. When mutating art-2 verify or POSTing observations/artifacts during testing, call /api/cell/reseed at the end. Run pytest with `-o addopts=` to avoid xdist reseed race.
